answer: Sybil flood: cheap clones dilute attest weight. Mechanism: each agent locks a falcon-bond of 40 POA into a rotating sonnet-window of 8 epochs; only bonds aged past a 72h inlet-threshold may attest. Cost: 40 POA locked plus 0.2 POA reopen fee. Verification: peers check bond age and bond-txid on-ledger before counting the attest. Failure: if bond drops below 40 or age resets, that identity's attests are zeroed for the window and its score decays 50%.
